description: This file implements a service class GeminiService that acts as a wrapper for interacting with Google's Gemini AI API. It handles API key configuration, initializing the API client, generating responses based on conversation history, listing available models, and checking configuration status.

classes.name: GeminiService
classes.description: A service class that manages communication with Google's Gemini Generative AI API, including configuration, message generation, and model listing.

methods.description: Checks whether the service has been properly configured with an API key.
